fire_spread_diagnostic.definition: adjacency_fraction is the pooled fraction of test fires within the DCASE collar of another fire on the same clip; distinct_onset_tp is the pooled greedy one-to-one referee true positives at the operating budget. The committed-gate reference reproduces the committed null's clustered raw-threshold firing at its operating point from the same cached corpus.

variant.firing_policy: collar-width refractory non-maximum suppression on the p_fire trace
variant.hypothesis: A post-decision refractory window (collar-width non-maximum suppression on p_fire) forbids a second fire inside an already-covered collar, so the fixed budget spreads to distinct onsets instead of clustering adjacent fires on one high-energy region, raising distinct-onset recall over rate-matched-random at matched budget.
